title: docs: add current dashboard screenshots to the guides
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Replaced three outdated Connect User Wallets screenshots with current views of app-key creation and the signed-out and signed-in consent screens. Added dashboard screenshots to the authentication, agent-publishing, model-publishing and sandboxes guides, so readers can match each step to its dialog or page. The sandboxes guide now also links directly to the dashboard for creating and managing sandboxes.

Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, small rounded light blue translucent wings and tiny librarian glasses; she is small within the scene, in strictly pixel art style, with cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
